output.summary: A perennial aromatic herb native across much of Eurasia, from France to Japan. Its strongly scented, heavily branched stems are often purple-tinged, while young sea-green, silky-haired growth becomes yellowish and smooth at maturity. Young leaves are recorded as edible when cooked, although this use is minor and not widely documented.
